$comment_block: D1 validation A/B for the holon watchdog latch. Root cause: on simbench_lv_small the pv_peak net is born infeasible (monee stepper fails steps 0-4, t=0..0.47), so the environment serves observers the unsolved constructor net (multi_energy_monee.py:262-271). SCARE's component-scope supply-priority ADMM runs its first gas solve at t=0.04 on those constructor readings — gas supply=0.0010 against demand=1.0019, identical to 4 dp across every seed — and correctly waterfalls gas tiers 3-4 to zero. The physics recovers by ~t=0.5, but the forced-republish watchdogs (HolonSummaryRole / HolonicCommunityRole / CPPriorityAdmmRole) all ran at watchdog_s=30.0, equal to simulation_duration_s, so they never fire mid-run and the delta gate keeps the deficit allocation frozen: only 13 gas regulate writes in the whole 30 s run, gas served 0.364 vs 0.745/0.767 for the weak baselines and 0.831 for the oracle. Arms sweep holon_watchdog_s; 30.0 reproduces the published behaviour byte-for-byte.
name: eval_watchdog_ab

experiments.$comment: Primary A/B. 30.0 == the shipped default and must reproduce the published gas collapse exactly; the lower values arm the recovery path. Success = gas served fraction recovers toward the component_level level (0.745) without giving back SCARE's electricity advantage (0.846 matched).
experiments.name: watchdog_pv_peak

experiments.$comment: Reference arm: the same 15 seeds under the three non-SCARE variants, so the recovered gas number has the matched 0.745 / 0.767 / 0.831 comparison on the same failure draws rather than against the pooled campaign.
experiments.name: watchdog_pv_peak_reference

experiments.$comment: Negative control on a scenario whose physics solves from step 0. The gas ADMM already returns all-1.0 at t=0.04 here, so no arm should move: any delta is the watchdog perturbing a healthy run, which would make the pv_peak gain untrustworthy.
experiments.name: watchdog_clean_control

experiments.$comment: Generalisation check: the same latch should bite anywhere a deficit allocation is computed early and never revised. simbench_lv under generator failure at slack 0.15 is the campaign's other low-PWSF, low-compliance regime (0.728 PWSF, 58% compliance).
experiments.name: watchdog_generator_deficit

experiments.$comment: D2b: nodal-heat-balance regulariser. monee's Node.calc_signed_heat_flow reads grid.node_heat_reg_kgs to keep d(heat_bal)/dT_n non-zero at zero mass flow; no grid class declared it, so it was always 0.0. Reproduced under the live formulation (HEAT_NONCONVEX_MIQCQP on Pyomo+Gurobi): a zero-flow junction lands at exactly 0.3*t_ref_k = 106.800000 K; 1e-6 restores 356.000000 K and moves a determined node by 2.2e-5 K. 1e-8 does not bite. The oracle swaps in the McCormick heat MILP and is immune either way, which is why the campaign's 306 sub-ambient readings are all MAS-side. cp_heavy carries 300 of them. Arm 0.0 reproduces the published behaviour exactly. Success = sub-ambient t_k records go to ~0 without moving PWSF on the flowing majority.
experiments.name: heat_regulariser_ab

experiments.$comment: D4: oracle time budget. 400 of the 469 time-limited solves in eval_full_v2 stopped at the 300s default and NONE were on a hard grid (simbench_lv 248 with p90 gap 0.45, cp_heavy_dependent 91, cp_heavy 40, cp_dependent 21); the 69 that got 900s were the allowlisted ones. Every one had a feasible incumbent, so the budget buys bound-tightening, not feasibility. Measures how much of the uncertified 32.7% a longer budget actually converts, before spending it campaign-wide.
experiments.name: oracle_budget_ab
